rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a residential area on the outskirts of a city.

example.english: We moved to a suburb where there are schools, markets, and restaurants nearby, so life is quite convenient.
example.traditional: 我哋搬咗去市郊住，附近有學校、街市同餐廳，生活都幾方便。
